title: Intercantonal agreements (concordats) by domain — signatory-canton counting
source: LexFind (Institute of Federalism, University of Fribourg)
methodology: chstat/BADAC 2003: each agreement counts once per signatory canton (an agreement signed by 10 cantons counts 10). Signatory set per agreement = cantons publishing the text in their collections ∪ cantons named in any language version's title.
notes: THE computed concordats statistic: each agreement counts once per signing canton (signed by 10 cantons → 10 occurrences), purely from the source data — no scaling, no external baseline
Signatories per agreement = cantons publishing the text in their collections ∪ cantons named in any language version's title; LexFind/LexWork publish no official member lists

chstat.ch/BADAC's 2003 figure (2,522 memberships ≤2003) is an external reference only — our computed ≤2003 value is lower because agreements repealed decades ago were delisted from today's collections (historical attrition); see the verification report
Distinct agreements with their signatory sets: /api/v1/stats/concordats_signatories.json
